notes:
Opportunity summary: Argentum is a mid-size payments/fintech platform building real-time personalization and fraud/risk reranking pipelines. Heavy emphasis on deterministic latency at p99 and predictable throughput for peak trading windows. They want to evaluate Redwood Dedicated with multi-region reserved GPU pools and a concrete failover headroom plan.

Key technical asks (from SE workshop 2026-03-02):
- Throughput target: 8k-12k tokens/sec sustained during peak (endpoints across 3 regions).
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 80ms, p99 < 180ms for short-chat models (<= 256 tokens). Reranking SLO tighter: p95 < 60ms.
- Failover/headroom requirement: 25-40% spare capacity per region to handle zone failures and cross-region failover; documented cold-start recovery < 120s.
- Reserved pool sizing: initial commit for 40 A100-equivalent GPUs split 50% primary NA, 30% EU, 20% APAC with cross-region bursting to handle weekday peak. Want worksheet showing how pools map to QPS and token budget.
- Preferred hardware: A100 or equivalent; open to mix (H100 for low-latency tails) if cost/latency tradeoff shown.
- Model strategy: prefer a primary high-accuracy model and lightweight fallback quantized variant for lowest-cost routing. Need recommendation for quantization profile and expected perf delta.
- Routing: smart routing policy required: local region preference, fallback to secondary region only when latency SLO can still be met, cost-policy for non-critical traffic.

Security / Compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) + enterprise KMS for key control.
- Data residency: EU region must retain raw logs for payments for 30 days in EU only - influences where KV cache/audit logs are stored and replication policy.
- SOC2 + ISO27001 required for procurement; asked for security FAQ + pen-test report (link requested).

Commercial / SLA negotiation items:
- Target SLA: 99.95% regional availability for Dedicated pools with 30-minute RTO for failover. Customer requests a tiered credit/penalty schedule tied to per-route p99 latency regressions during a calendar month.
- Pricing: prefer a blended reserved-rate commit with burst credits for cross-region emergencies. Request a model for committed vs burst compute unit pricing and overage billing.
- Contract ask: 12-24 month reserved term with quarterly checkpoints and optional capacity rebalancing clause.

Recent timeline (short):
- 2026-01-28: Intro call (AE + SE) - discovery of latency/cost goals (ff_2026-02-05_argentum_kickoff).
- 2026-02-05: Security intake submitted by Argentum security team (linked to RDW-1423).

- 2026-03-10: Legal sent initial SLA redlines; procurement tracking started.

- SLA draft with uptime and latency SLOs + proposed credit schedule.
